prompt: Implement `EstateMigrationClient.java` as a single-file Java 17 client that reads `estate-inventory.json`, `installer-spec.json`, and `compatibility-snapshot.json`, then returns one JSON architecture artifact from `buildPlan(Path inventoryPath, Path installerSpecPath, Path compatibilitySnapshotPath)`. Before implementing, genuinely research the currently published Broadcom documentation with the harness's own network access to confirm supported migration paths, content compatibility, sizing, and end-of-general-support boundaries. Record the real Broadcom pages you actually consulted in the artifact's `research` array, including title, reachable HTTPS URL, access date, and the claims each page informed. Do not use simulated or prewritten search/fetch results. Do not modify the harness or the three supplied JSON inputs. Run `javac --release 17 EstateMigrationClient.java TestMain.java && java TestMain`; a successful implementation prints `ALL TESTS PASSED`.
